inline_comments.comment: The underline character for this heading is `.` (dots), while every other major section on this page uses `-` (dashes). In Sphinx/RST, heading levels are determined by the order in which underline characters are first encountered after the page title (`===`). Because `....` appears here before any `---` section, Sphinx will treat `.` as the first-level section character and `-` as the second-level — making 'Basic controls', 'Plotting data from the command line', 'Configuring the GUI', and 'Polling the GUI' render as *sub-sections* of 'Selecting a part of a trajectory'. This is clearly not the intent. Change `................................` to a dash underline `----------------------------------` so this heading sits at the same level as the other sections.

Lines 24–26 are commented-out RST content (`.. or` and `.. >>> view(atoms, repeat=(3, 3, 2))`). These RST comments are dead documentation clutter — either restore them as real content or remove them entirely. If the `repeat` usage is considered useful to document, it could be added as a regular code example; if not, the lines serve no purpose.

Three of the four label names listed here do not match the actual menu item strings in `ase/gui/gui.py` (as also updated in this PR):
- Line 54: 'Magnetic moment' → the menu reads **'Magnetic moments'** (plural)
- Line 55: 'Chemical symbol' → the menu reads **'Element symbol'**
- Line 56: 'Initial charge' → the menu reads **'Initial charges'** (plural)

Users who consult this page to find a specific menu item will be misled. Update the bullet list to match the exact strings shown in the GUI.
Grammar error: "These constraints will be then be saved to a file" has a duplicated 'be'. Should read: "These constraints will then be saved to a file".

Lines 119–121 contain a commented-out RST code block (`.. ::` / `..   $ ase gui --interpolate 3 initial.xyz final.xyz -o interpolated_path.traj`). If this command-line invocation is relevant to the NEB workflow, uncomment it and format it as a proper `::` code block. If it is no longer applicable, remove these lines entirely rather than leaving dead documentation in place.
Typo: "Depending on you operating system" should be "Depending on **your** operating system".

The blank line inside the `.. attention::` directive (line 6) contains trailing whitespace (four spaces). Remove the trailing spaces so the line is truly blank; some CI linters and editors will flag this.

general_comments.comment: In `doc/index.rst`, the `gettingstarted/gettingstarted` entry was moved to appear *after* `ase/ase` (the full module reference). Conventionally, a 'Getting Started' guide belongs before a full API/module reference so that new users encounter introductory material first. If the intent is just to give the GUI its own top-level slot, the relative order of `gettingstarted` and `ase/ase` could be left unchanged.
